sign_off.notes: Not fully covered. I could not read the analytics savings card, which is hidden behind the "New budget period" button. I did not exercise the budget settings beyond opening the sheet. In history editing I checked amount and date edits on Groceries and Rent. Two of my three reports got "could not reproduce" from the developer: the empty history panel (before I found the pull-down gesture) and the analytics bottom-card overlap. The third report is the Charge day staying at Day 13 after Rent's date changed to 12 November. It was reproduced once on this device, and the developer's reply to that one was also "could not reproduce". Treat that one as a real open issue.
